name: ALIBABA
description: Alibaba Java Coding Guidelines - focuses on security, performance and code style.

rules.name: SQL injection risk
rules.description: User input must never be concatenated into a SQL statement; use a precompiled PreparedStatement.
rules.suggestion: Bind parameters with a PreparedStatement '?' placeholder or MyBatis '#{}'.

rules.name: Hard-coded secrets
rules.description: Passwords, keys, tokens and other secrets must not be hard-coded in source.
rules.suggestion: Move secrets into a config file or config service, and store them encrypted.

rules.name: No System.out logging
rules.description: System.out/err must not be used for logging in production; use a logging framework.
rules.suggestion: Use a logging framework such as SLF4J, e.g. log.info().

rules.name: No printStackTrace
rules.description: Exception handlers must not call printStackTrace(), which writes the stack trace to stderr.
rules.suggestion: Record the stack trace with log.error("message", e).

rules.name: Thread pool creation
rules.description: Do not create threads directly - use a thread pool. Do not build pools via Executors; use ThreadPoolExecutor.
rules.suggestion: Construct a ThreadPoolExecutor explicitly, specifying core size, max size, queue and rejection policy.

rules.name: Class naming convention
rules.suggestion: Class names should start with a capital letter, e.g. UserController.

rules.name: Constant naming convention
rules.description: Constant names must be all upper case with underscores between words.
rules.suggestion: Constants should be upper case with underscores, e.g. MAX_STOCK_COUNT.

rules.name: Package naming convention
rules.description: Package names must be lower case, with exactly one meaningful English word between dots.
rules.suggestion: Package names should be all lower case, e.g. com.example.ai.util.

rules.name: No magic numbers
rules.description: Undefined magic values must not appear in the code.
rules.suggestion: Extract the number into a named constant that carries its business meaning.

rules.name: Switch missing default
rules.description: A switch statement must include a default block.
rules.suggestion: Add a default branch to the switch to handle unexpected values.

rules.name: Long comparison
rules.description: Long values must be compared with equals(), never with ==.
rules.suggestion: Compare with Objects.equals() or Long.equals(); Long instances outside -128..127 are not cached.

rules.name: Avoid Apache BeanUtils
rules.description: Apache BeanUtils performs poorly and should be avoided.
rules.suggestion: Use Spring BeanUtils or Cglib BeanCopier instead.

rules.name: Transactional annotation usage
rules.description: @Transactional should only be applied to public methods.
rules.suggestion: Move @Transactional to a public method or the class, otherwise the transaction may not apply.

rules.name: Collection initialisation
rules.description: Specify an initial capacity when creating a collection where possible.
rules.suggestion: Give collections an initial capacity to avoid repeated resizing, e.g. new HashMap<>(16).

rules.name: Floating-point comparison
rules.description: Floating-point equality must not use == for primitives, nor equals() for wrapper types.
rules.suggestion: Use BigDecimal for exact arithmetic and comparison, or compare within an epsilon.
